points: \item Implemented a self-correcting RAG system using LangChain and Mistral 7B, improving answer reliability and mitigating context errors in mission-critical agentic systems.
\item Built a hybrid retrieval workflow combining dense embeddings and BM25 search, enhancing relevance and coverage of retrieved documents for complex operational challenges.
\item Developed an LLM-as-Judge evaluation pipeline to assess faithfulness and relevance across hundreds of QA examples, ensuring reliable benchmarking of agent behavior.
\item Introduced batched query extraction using Python and SQL, reducing LLM calls by ~80% per query and optimizing inference for large-scale labeling tasks.
\item Designed an ML-based anomaly detection system for workflows, reducing redundant prompts by 25%, enhancing the robustness of automated perception systems.
\item Containerized and deployed scalable AI solutions using Docker and AWS, ensuring secure pipelines for government and defense applications.
